about: One row per distinct finding shape (source, check, kind, rule, cause, page, where) of the accessibility artifacts read through .github/scripts/lib/a11y-ledger.mjs readA11yArtifacts(): the audit of 2026-11-10 on develop at 8b36d609, the A11y nightly run 42763025203 (all seven checks beyond axe and the axe scan), the Screen reader nightly run 42756854209 (39 scenarios on the four reader projects) and the Docs a11y run 42798005360 (the docs site scan, tests/a11y/docs/, against the develop staging deploy). Regenerate with the collector over a night's artifacts and dedupe by the shape; the triage ratchet in tests/lib/__tests__/a11y-issues.test.mjs reads this file. Every row of the gating axe scan has the kind axe-violation, the one kind the ledger gives that scan's findings, baselined or new. The docs site checks (source docs-checks) add one row per shape across pages, on the first page that showed it, from the Docs a11y proof run 42821567137 of 2026-11-10 on the branch that added them; a shape its later fix no longer produces is left out. The context-change-on-input row is from a local run of the same checks against staging on 2026-11-12, after the review fixes.
